svg.title: Maximum context at 262K and 12K gives the same 8K-input boundary
svg.desc: Four groups show three p95 time-to-first-token trials each for the 8K-input 1K-output workload. The server maximum-context settings of 262K and 12K both pass concurrency seven near 8.7 seconds and fail concurrency eight near 10.67 seconds, with the ten-second SLO marked.
